events.title: October 22 Demo Update: New Prototype Enemies
events.summary: The BALLRENA demo has been updated. Thank you for playing and sharing your suggestions. We've listened carefully to your feedback and used it to guide these changes. This update adds three Prototype enemies, new artwork and animations for enemies and friendly units, and changes to several combat mechanics and arenas. events.title: Demo Update: Thanks for Your Feedback!
events.summary: The BALLRENA demo has been updated! Thank you for playing, sharing your builds, and telling us where things could feel better. We've listened carefully to your feedback and used it to shape this update. Putting a build together should now feel smoother. Rerolls offer different cards, with more variety among T2 red cards and fewer repeat upgrade choices. events.title: BALLRENA Developer Livestream: Gameplay & Commentary
events.summary: Welcome to the BALLRENA developer livestream! Join us for about 90 minutes of live gameplay and commentary. Watch the game in action and hear the thinking behind the choices made during the run. Feel free to share your thoughts and feedback in chat. Enjoying BALLRENA?
